chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Bazi'e, who said:

I asked Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about the man who has intercourse with the woman in what is besides the private part, and the woman discharges [semen/fluid], upon her is the washing. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.

key_terms.فِيمَا دُونَ الْفَرْجِ: in what is besides the private part (non-penetrative)

ai.seo_question: Does a woman need to perform ghusl if she discharges fluid during sexual intimacy without full penetration?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific conditions for obligatory ghusl, establishing that discharge of semen (mani) during sexual intimacy—even without full penetration (jam' ba'd al-jum'ah)—necessitates the ritual bath for the woman. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the principle that the presence of seminal fluid, rather than the act of penetration itself, is the primary trigger for major ritual impurity requiring purification before prayer.
